versions.content: Status values naming convention: The following naming rules apply for status values that are visible outside of the module: - Status values shall have only CAPITAL LETTERS - Naming convention: FRTRCV_<STATUSNAME> If <STATUSNAME> consists of several words, they shall be separated by underscores.
